_comment: TEST FIXTURE — not live data. Shape mirrors a real UK Contracts Finder response (POST /api/rest/2/search_notices/json) so the mapper in scripts/import-tenders.mjs can be verified without network access. Values are invented; HTML entities and a value-less notice are included on purpose to exercise the decoder and the validator.

noticeList.title: Supply & install of 12 EV charge points across council depots
noticeList.description:
Bristol City Council invites tenders for the supply, installation and commissioning of 12 dual-socket electric vehicle charge points at four depot sites. Works include groundworks, cable routing, DNO notification and integration with the existing back-office system.

The contractor will be responsible for OZEV grant documentation. Site surveys are available on request.

noticeList.title: Replacement of legacy patient records dashboard
noticeList.description: We require a partner to design and build a replacement web dashboard for operational patient-flow reporting, integrating with an existing FHIR endpoint and a Microsoft SQL data warehouse. Deliverables include a design system, role-based access control and a phased migration off the current tool.

noticeList.title: Machined stainless steel valve bodies – 400 units
noticeList.description: Manufacture and supply of 400 machined 316L stainless steel valve bodies to supplied drawings, including first-article inspection, material certification to EN 10204 3.1 and dimensional reports per batch. Fitting tolerances are critical, see the attached drawing pack.

noticeList.title: Seasonal coastal path repairs and resurfacing
noticeList.description: Routine and reactive repairs to 14km of coastal footpath, including edge protection, drainage clearance and resurfacing with a compacted aggregate finish. Works must avoid the bird-nesting season between March and August.

noticeList.title: Tender with no published value
noticeList.description: This notice deliberately carries no valueLow or valueHigh, so the importer must reject it rather than invent a budget for the compatibility engine to score against.
